data.name: Muzain
data.gender_notes: Muzain is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who is strong in faith
data.long_meaning: The one who strengthens the faith of others and himself through his actions and words. He is someone who is steadfast in his beliefs and is a source of guidance and support for others. The name Muzain carries the meaning “One who is strong in faith” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Muzain usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is strong in faith and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Muzain belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who is strong in faith.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muzain total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
